findingDetails.title: The intent vocabulary has no prose form for Aside, so a request that names Aside either defers or silently drops it from a bundle
findingDetails.scopeProof: The gap is one vocabulary class in one file. Every Aside keyword carries a qualifier while BLADEBRO carries bare bladebro; replaying the two prompts through evaluateRoute returns defer and a two-mode orderedBundle; all sixteen canary cases pass, so the defect sits outside the fixture coverage rather than in the fix.

results.summary: Goal criterion 5 still holds: the advisor returns the hub for each mode own prompt and the compiled router returns that mode. The new P1 does not touch it because each single-mode request in the criterion is written in a form the vocabulary covers.

Phase 015 criterion 1 holds literally on the id form and criterion 2 holds as behaviour: the five probe prompts, the doctor control row, the four staging probes and the disclosed 0.45 anchor limitation all reproduce. The coverage note is that criterion 1 canary prompt spells the three ids, which is what the new P1 records.

noveltyJustification: Weighted new = 5 (one P1). Weighted total = 5 new + 9 carried (one P1 at 5, four P2 at 1 each) = 14. Ratio 5/14 = 0.3571. The finding is new: no prior iteration compiled the router or replayed the canary cases, so the prose-form gap was not reachable from reading alone.
